newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian shipyard says wins $150 mln foreign order.
newsitem.headline: Croatian shipyard says wins $150 mln foreign order.

text.p: Croatian shipyard 3. Maj said on Tuesday it had won a new $150 million order to build two oil tankers for Scorpio Ship Management from Monte Carlo and another two under option.
The first two of four identical 70,700-tonne tankers will be completed for delivery in 1999, and the other two in 2000, 3. Maj said in a press release faxed to Reuters.
The agreement was signed on February 8. The shipyard built two vessels for the same company in 1986, it said.
The deal will boost 3. Maj's order book, which has only three other vessels due for construction for a Chinese-Polish shipper Chipolbrok, and enable further business restructuring.
"It is a significant step towards establishing a better position of 3. Maj in Croatia and on the world shipbuilding market," the statement said.
The shipyard has just completed a large Russian order.
